en: Windows: Fixed the session scratchpad and other temporary paths growing with your project's path length in sessions not started by Claude Desktop, which made repositories cloned into them hit the 260-character path limit
zh: Windows：修复了在非 Claude Desktop 启动的 session 中，session 暂存区及其他临时路径随项目路径长度增长的问题，该问题导致克隆到其中的仓库触及 260 字符路径上限
